lots.guide_summary: No SOLD result outside Gowans was found. Range runs from a passed-in Lawsons Afghan Bokhara of similar size (estimate A$600-800, midpoint A$700, category guide, UNSOLD) to an Australian retail asking price of A$1,749 for a slightly larger chobi Ziegler (ASKING, marked sold with no price). A UK dealer asking GBP 1,535 (about A$3,150 at approx 2.05) for a much larger chobi is noted but outside the range. So: 0 sold, 1 unsold, 2 asking. Retail asking prices for new chobi rugs sit far above what modern Afghan rugs make at Australian auction.
lots.working: No surviving non-Gowans SOLD entry, so keep_max_hammer = 0 and flip_max_hammer = 0 on this pass. Formulae for reference: keep = lowest same-item SOLD AUD / 1.198, flip = (resale less fees and postage) / 2.396, both rounded down to the nearest $5. (The earlier Gowans-comps pass found Gowans sold results, which were excluded here as instructed.) The Lawsons pass-in at an estimate of A$600-800 suggests even a similar-size new Afghan rug can fail to clear A$600 at a city auction.
lots.confidence_reason: Rests on asking and unsold evidence only. Identification (chobi/Ziegler style) is credible from the photo and Gowans title, but only the top half of the rug is shown and the size is from the title, not measured.

lots.key_photo_findings: One photo, showing the top half of the rug hung over a rail. Brick-red/rust abrashed field, large ivory and olive palmettes and rosettes on vine scrolls, ivory guard border with brown floral meander, typical Afghan chobi/Ziegler look. Pile looks full and even; ends with short fringe visible at the bottom fold. No stains, moth or wear visible in the part shown. No label readable. Lower half and back not shown.
lots.condition: Appears good to very good in the half shown; lower half, back, fringes and edges unseen.
lots.question_for_gowans: Can you confirm the full rug is in the same condition as the photographed half (no stains, moth damage, worn pile, edge or fringe damage), whether there is a maker's or import label on the back, and the measured size? Could you send a photo of the full rug and the back?
